knowledge_base.fact: Standard playing cards and MTG cards measure 2.5 inches × 3.5 inches (63.5mm × 88.9mm).
knowledge_base.title: Playing Card Dimensions

knowledge_base.fact: Pokemon sprite images from PokeAPI are typically 96×96 pixels.
knowledge_base.title: Pokemon Sprite Dimensions

knowledge_base.fact: 300 DPI is standard for print, 600 DPI for high-quality archival prints.
knowledge_base.title: Print Resolution Standards

knowledge_base.fact: At 300 DPI: 1 inch = 300 pixels, 2.5 inches = 750 pixels, 3.5 inches = 1050 pixels.
knowledge_base.title: Pixel to Inch Conversion
